The quotation names two specific mechanisms: (1) financial pressures on universities (institutional finance/viability) and (2) students needing confidence in course quality (education quality assurance). Both are squarely about higher education institutions and their students — the core subject matter of I2 (Education and Research Institutions). The financial pressures on universities could secondarily touch on G (financial economics of institutions) but the framing is about educational outcomes and institutional sustainability in an educational context, not financial markets per se.
